messages:
Anya: quick PSA — noticed weird double billing for resumed SSE sessions after the console metric rollout.
Greg: saw the alert. reconnects are fine but billing events show 2 increments for the same resume window.
Shreya: any repro steps? could be resume-id header getting lost and client falling back to fresh token.
Anya: tiny repro: open stream -> drop -> resume within 3s. server returns 204 resume-accepted but billing shows two charges. logs:
Anya: ```
Client -> POST /v1/streams/resume
  X-Resume-ID: resume-xyz-123
Proxy -> (retries) strips X-Resume-ID on retry
Server -> 204
Billing -> increment tokens for new session
```
Greg: proxy's retry code path intentionally rebuilds req without some headers. Oops.
ConsoleUI: FYI our console sampling fraction was changed to 5% last week; metering is unsampled -> correlation gap.
Shreya: root cause: resume idempotency depends on header propagation. Metering needs resume fingerprint too so sampling doesn't hide duplicates.
Greg: short term: update proxy to preserve X-Resume-ID across retries. I'll open PR for a patched header pass-through.
Anya: can we also mute billing increments if resume fingerprint seen within 15s? safer to avoid billing blips.
Shreya: agreed. propose: attach resume-fingerprint to meter events, dedupe server-side for a configurable window. default 15s.
DeployBot: canary rollout at 12% -> paused due to error spike, rolling back to 11%.
Greg: I'll push proxy fix to canary first. Shreya, can you spec the meter change so we can coordinate rollback if needed?
Shreya: will write design doc + migration steps. Add feature flag "resume_meter_dedupe". Also add console dashboard: "resume_charges" vs "unique_resume_fps".
Anya: i'll create a Grafana card and alert: resume_charges / unique_resume_fps > 1.02 for 10m.
Greg: tagging @eng-infra for release window. thanks.
ConsoleUI: reminder: surface a small tooltip for users about "resume attempts" in the debug drawer.
Anya: thanks team. follow-ups: PRs for proxy + meter, dashboard card, and a small e2e test that kills connections and asserts single charge. :thumbsup:
